items.title: Logistics firms set for strong Q1 revenue growth despite margin pressure
items.description: Logistics sector revenue is poised for healthy growth in the June quarter. This expansion is driven by e-commerce demand and increased supply-chain outsourcing. However, elevated fuel costs and pricing pressures may impact profitability across companies. Container Corporation of India and Delhivery anticipate revenue increases with margin challenges. Blue Dart Express and TCI also expect revenue growth, with fuel prices being key.

items.title: Investors are watching Jio but Mukesh Ambani-led RIL’s Q1 surprise may come from refining
items.description: Reliance Industries' upcoming first-quarter earnings may depend on refining gains.  Jio's steady expansion is expected to provide a stable growth engine for the company.  Refining margins surged dramatically, raising expectations for the oil-to-chemicals business.  However, planned refinery shutdowns could impact the full benefit of margin upswings.  Investors will focus on how well RIL translates commodity margins into actual earnings.

items.title: Wipro's strong deal wins offset by weak revenue and margin decline
items.description: Wipro reported strong order bookings but saw revenue decline and margins contract.  The company's management noted no significant demand changes from the prior quarter.  Future revenue guidance remains cautious, expecting a slight drop or marginal improvement.  However, annual revenue trends show moderation, aided by acquisitions and steady orders.  Stock valuation reflects investor sentiment, awaiting revenue and profitability improvements.

items.title: Reliance Industries shares jump 2% ahead of Mukesh Ambani-led company’s Q1 earnings. How to trade stock today?
items.description: Reliance Industries will announce its June quarter results today, with investors watching share price movements. Analysts anticipate steady performance driven by oil-to-chemicals and digital services growth. Previous earnings reports show mixed reactions, with some post-earnings gains and declines.
